.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r2/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/ (tests/Dockerfile, test.sh, tools/score.py, tools/restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, all five judge.toml [judge] blocks)
evidence: (1) Shared pinned judge agent + model: task/task.toml:30-35 is byte-identical to the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md: REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". All five judge.toml [judge] blocks (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only judge = "claude-code" fallback, mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template; grep for model|temperature|reasoning in task/tests/*/*/judge.toml returned nothing. The [judge]..[scoring] sections diff-identical to the template for all five dimensions (functional timeout 9000, polish/visual 900, gates 600 match template). (2) Pinned judge CLIs and browser: task/tests/Dockerfile is diff-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/Dockerfile: node:22-bookworm-slim + python:3.12-slim bases; npm -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22); pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31); Chromium installed through the pinned @playwright/mcp's bundled playwright CLI into /opt/playwright-browsers and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 33-39), which every judge.toml passes via --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Only apt packages (ca-certificates, procps, fonts...) are unpinned, which the Deterministic Checks sheet C11 classifies as NOTE, and they are template-controlled. (3) Shared tools: tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and tests/scoring.toml are byte-identical (diff -q) to the template, so check-canonical-shared-files.py's code comparison would trivially hold. (4) Graded time rules on a fixed clock: the brief/rules contain no calendar-dependent graded rule (no ages, SLAs, overdue, 'today', relative 'x ago' displays); grep of all judge.toml/prompt.md/app_context.md for ago|today|yesterday|date|20xx-|overdue|SLA found none. The only graded durations are the relative 15-second live-update windows (hireops_rules.md:117; functional judge.toml:290,299,335,344,353; polish judge.toml:23,32; functional prompt.md:41,47; polish prompt.md:14), which are measured from the judge's own action and do not depend on the run date. Activity 'newest first' (hireops_rules.md:112, functional judge.toml:263) and conversation recency (hireops_rules.md:144-165) are relative orderings; seed timestamps are fixed and all in the past (2026-07-01..2026-07-29Z) so new run-time events (golden uses new Date().toISOString(), src/index.js:59) sort after seeded ones regardless of run day. Because there is no date-dependent rule, no fixed clock is needed for grading to be stable across run dates; the absence of a stated fixed clock is consistent with this row (whether the brief must state one is row 4's concern, not this one). (5) Network: [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" (task.toml:37-38) - explicitly not a defect per workbook D48 and SKILL delivery profile. Adversarial probes: a broken app cannot exploit the verifier config (no task-local judge/model override, judge selection lives only in [verifier.env]); a conforming alternative that uses sequence IDs or its own clock for ordering still satisfies every time-related criterion because none grades absolute times. Residual latent item (P3-equivalent, template-controlled, not a task defect): base images are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned, and the Chromium build is pinned transitively through @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 rather than by a separate version string; this is identical in the frozen template. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json lists only scripted golden observations in image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair, explicitly 'Not a configured judge run'; no full configured judge run exists, so that the claude-code CLI actually invoked GLM through OpenRouter in this image is NOT EXERCISED. This row is a static configuration/pinning check fully decidable from the bytes, so that gap does not change the verdict, but it remains an open item for the verifier-launch rows.
